title: ruellia serrana
intro: Ruellia serrana, commonly known as Serra ruellia, is a plant species belonging to the Acanthaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that help in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Ruellia serrana are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
